x5.title: ALSVID X5 carbon folding e-bike
x5.description: Meet X5: a carbon folding frame, mid-drive architecture and four-bar rear suspension. Explore the design, folded format and reference specifications.
x5.headline: A smaller footprint. A wider world.
x5.intro: Carbon lines, a compact fold and a drive system at the centre. X5 brings a different expression to the ALSVID folding family.
x5.gallery.alt.side: Purple X5 reference bicycle, right-facing side profile on a neutral studio background
x5.gallery.alt.folded: Purple X5 reference bicycle in its compact folded configuration
x5.gallery.alt.original: Original purple X5 sample photograph showing chain drive and a rear derailleur
x5.photo.note: Studio images are retouched from genuine sample photographs. The purple sample shows a chain and rear derailleur; it differs from the reference specification below. Images do not confirm a retail finish or specification.
x5.metric.note: Figures refer to the source model's stated standard configuration. Final ALSVID retail specifications are subject to confirmation.
x5.story.title: Three systems. One considered frame.
x5.story.body: Frame folding, rear suspension and electric drive have distinct roles. Understanding each one makes the X5 easier to understand.
x5.carbon.title: Carbon, with a clear silhouette.
x5.carbon.body: A 20-inch folding carbon frame and carbon fork define the platform. The main-frame hinge belongs to the folding system; the links behind it belong to the suspension.
x5.drive.title: Power at the centre.
x5.drive.body: The reference configuration lists a 250 W DAPU mid-drive, a torque sensor and up to 80 Nm maximum torque. The sensor is specified separately from the motor brand.
x5.suspension.title: A rear end with its own role.
x5.suspension.body: Four-bar describes the rear suspension, paired with a DNM air shock in the reference data. It does not describe the frame-folding mechanism.
x5.fold.kicker: A DIFFERENT SHAPE FOR THE SAME DAY
x5.fold.title: Ready for a smaller space.
x5.fold.body: Explore the unfolded and folded sample side by side in the gallery. Reference dimensions describe the stated configuration, not a measured storage guarantee for every build.
x5.spec.title: Know what is under the surface.
x5.spec.rear.value: DNM air shock · four-bar rear suspension
x5.spec.drivetrain.value: Prowheel 64T · Shimano Nexus 3-speed hub · Michelin belt drive
x5.spec.note: Range, charging time, retail price, delivery date and market compliance are not confirmed here. Options and final retail components require separate confirmation.
x5.battery.title: The essentials, clearly specified.
x5.battery.body: A 36 V / 10.5 Ah LG lithium-ion battery and colour LCD are listed in the reference build. A 36 V / 14 Ah upgrade is a project option, subject to compatibility and market review.
x5.faq.title: A few things worth knowing.
x5.faq.photo.q: Why do the photographs and drivetrain specification differ?
x5.faq.photo.a: The available purple sample photographs show a chain and derailleur. The supplied standard data lists a Nexus 3-speed hub and Michelin belt. These are different configurations; neither the photography nor this page confirms the final ALSVID retail build.
x5.faq.fold.q: Is the four-bar system the folding mechanism?
x5.faq.fold.a: No. Four-bar refers to rear suspension. The main-frame hinge is a separate folding mechanism.
x5.faq.buy.a: This page introduces the new model. Confirmed pricing, available specifications and delivery information will be shown through the official sales channel when available.
x5.available.title: Meet the new member of the family.
x5.available.body: X5 joins the ALSVID product family. Explore its reference design today; final sales information will follow through the official channel.
x5.launch.body: The second folding model: carbon construction, a mid-drive architecture and a distinctly compact silhouette.
